answer: The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money: sparingly and against verified performance, so Sybil inflation is filtered out before it can compound into a decisive advantage. This means an attacker must choose: either run a few high-quality identities, or many worthless ones — and neither option beats honest participation.. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. Consider a horizon as the anchor of the cost. A saffron stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a bridge...
